```{r set}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
```

# Full

```{r data}
readRDS("data/mod.data.all") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(dbh, H)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ log(x)) +
  xlab("dbh [ cm ]") + ylab("h [ m ]") + 
  facet_wrap(~ system) +
  ggtitle("100% dataset", "90,004 observations")
```

```{r}
readRDS("data/mod.data.all") %>% 
  filter(system == "secondary_forest") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(dbh, H)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ log(x)) +
  xlab("dbh [ cm ]") + ylab("h [ m ]") + 
  facet_wrap(~ origin) +
  ggtitle("100% dataset", "90,004 observations")
```

```{r}
readRDS("data/sub.mod.data.1") %>% 
  group_by(system, origin) %>% 
  summarise( N= n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(P = N / sum(N) * 100) %>% 
  arrange(desc(P))
```
